why: What a caller actually decides is not WHETHER to run the query — it has a question either way — but how much of each node to ask for. So the quote is a table and `fits` is the verdict that turns it into a decision. A budget of one token cannot hold four nodes at any width in any serialization, which is what makes this assertion safe to freeze without pinning a byte of this corpus's prose: every row is over budget, including the pack, and a server that answered otherwise has not priced the payload it would send.
